name: redpanda-docs
description: Completion, hover, and build checks for prop:, propval:, and :page-categories: in Redpanda docs.

redpandaDocs.serverPath.description: Path to bin/docs-language-server.js. Empty uses the copy of @redpanda-data/docs-extensions-and-macros installed in the workspace, so the editor runs the same version as the build.

redpandaDocs.docsPath.description: A local checkout of redpanda-data/docs, passed to the server as REDPANDA_DOCS_PATH. Cloud pages read their property data from it, and repositories without the taxonomy read taxonomy.yml from it.
